sources.shortCitation: Hofmeister, February 1931, p. 35 — “Ihre Majestät — die Liebe! Schlagerheft”
sources.fullCitation: Walter Jurmann, Ihre Majestät — die Liebe!, Tonfilm: Schlagerheft [words by Bernauer and Oesterreicher], for voice and piano, 1931, 11 pp., containing “Du bist nicht die erste” (tango), “Mein Glück bist du” (English waltz), “Mein Fräulein, kennen Sie schon meinen Rhythmus” (foxtrot), “Ich denk an Mädi die ganze Nacht” (foxtrot) and “Mensch, mach dir nichts draus” (6/8). Berlin: Alrobi. Registered under “Jurmann, Walter” in Hofmeisters Musikalisch-literarischer Monatsbericht 103, no. 2 (February 1931): 35. Internet Archive scan, leaf n34.
sources.title: Hofmeisters Musikalisch-literarischer Monatsbericht: “Ihre Majestät — die Liebe! Schlagerheft”
sources.creator: Walter Jurmann (music); Rudolf Bernauer and Rudolf Oesterreicher (words)
sources.researchNote: The entry “Jurmann, Walter” lists, from the sound film Ihre Majestät — die Liebe!, a salon-orchestra arrangement of “Mensch, mach dir nichts draus!” and the film’s song folio with five songs, all under Jurmann’s name; Kaper is not named.

works.title: Ihre Majestät die Liebe
works.publicNote: Bronisław Kaper’s involvement is considered probable, but his role is not established. The only positive attribution is IMDb, which lists him as “Benjamin Kapper”; Filmportal and the Walter Jurmann works catalogue do not confirm it. Hofmeisters Musikalisch-literarischer Monatsbericht registers the film’s song folio, with “Du bist nicht die erste”, “Mein Glück bist du” and three other songs, under Walter Jurmann alone (February 1931: 35), as it does a brass-band arrangement of “Du bist nicht die Erste!” (July 1931: 152). The film had its premiere at the Gloria-Palast in Berlin on 9 January 1931, before the Jurmann–Kaper collaboration began.
